title: Conditional Sentences
goals: memahami tiga jenis **conditional sentence**: type 1, type 2, dan type 3
memakai **type 1** untuk kemungkinan nyata: [[If it rains, I will stay home.]]
memakai **type 2** untuk pengandaian yang tidak nyata di masa kini: [[If I were rich, I would travel.]]
memakai **type 3** untuk penyesalan di masa lalu: [[If I had studied, I would have passed.]]
memakai [[unless]], [[as long as]], [[provided that]], dan [[wish]] dengan benar
memilih tipe conditional yang tepat dari konteks kalimat

lesson.text: Kita sering membicarakan hal yang **mungkin terjadi**, **tidak nyata**, atau **sudah lewat dan tidak bisa diubah**. *Jika hujan, aku di rumah. Andai aku kaya, aku akan keliling dunia. Seandainya aku belajar, aku pasti lulus.* Semua itu memakai **conditional sentence** (kalimat pengandaian).

lesson.title: 2. Type 1 — kemungkinan nyata
table: [[If it rains, I will stay at home.]]
Jika hujan, aku akan di rumah.
[[If you study hard, you will pass the exam.]]
Jika kamu belajar giat, kamu akan lulus.
[[She will be late if she misses the bus.]]
Dia akan terlambat jika ketinggalan bus.
Jika es dipanaskan, es mencair. (fakta umum: present + present)

lesson.title: Dua klausa boleh bertukar tempat
lesson.text: [[If it rains, I will stay home.]] = [[I will stay home if it rains.]] Pakai **koma** jika *if-clause* di depan, tanpa koma jika di belakang.

lesson.title: 3. Type 2 — pengandaian tidak nyata
table: [[If I were rich, I would travel around the world.]]
Andai aku kaya, aku akan keliling dunia. (kenyataannya tidak kaya)
[[If she studied more, she would get better marks.]]
Andai dia belajar lebih banyak, nilainya lebih baik.
[[If I had a car, I would drive to school.]]
Andai aku punya mobil, aku akan menyetir ke sekolah.
[[What would you do if you won the lottery?]]
Apa yang akan kamu lakukan jika menang lotre?

lesson.title: Pakai were untuk semua subjek
lesson.text: Dalam type 2, bentuk [[to be]] biasanya **were** untuk semua subjek: [[If I were you, I would apologise.]] (bukan *If I was you*). [[If I were you, ...]] dipakai untuk memberi **saran**.

lesson.title: 4. Type 3 — penyesalan masa lalu
table: [[If I had studied, I would have passed the test.]]
Andai aku belajar, aku pasti lulus. (nyatanya tidak belajar, tidak lulus)
[[If they had left earlier, they wouldn't have missed the train.]]
Andai mereka berangkat lebih awal, mereka tidak ketinggalan kereta.
[[She would have won if she had practised.]]
[[If it hadn't rained, we would have gone to the beach.]]
Andai tidak hujan, kami pergi ke pantai.

items.ex: The condition is simple: study hard.
It is possible to finish today.
She passed the exam; he failed.
Unless you hurry, you will be late.
You can go as long as you come back early.
I'll lend it provided that you return it.

lesson.title: 6. Unless, as long as, dan wish
table: [[Unless you hurry, you will be late.]] = [[If you don't hurry, you will be late.]]
[[You can borrow it as long as you take care of it.]]

lesson.title: Jangan pakai will setelah if
lesson.text: Salah: *If it will rain, ...* Benar: [[If it rains, ...]]. Setelah **if** pada type 1 pakai **simple present**. Jangan pakai **would** setelah if pada type 2 atau 3.

lesson.title: Cara memilih tipe
lesson.text: Tanyakan: *Apakah ini mungkin terjadi?* Ya → **type 1**. *Tidak nyata sekarang?* → **type 2**. *Sudah terjadi dan tidak bisa diubah?* → **type 3**.

items: **Type 1**: if + present, will + V1 → kemungkinan nyata.
**Type 2**: if + past, would + V1 → andai sekarang (pakai [[were]]).
**Type 3**: if + had V3, would have V3 → penyesalan masa lalu.
[[unless]] = if not; [[as long as]] / [[provided that]] = asalkan.
[[I wish + past]] untuk sekarang; [[I wish + had V3]] untuk masa lalu.

qs.q: What would happen if more children could read?

read.text:
Rina: If I were rich, I would travel around the world. I would visit Japan first because I love cherry blossoms.
Doni: If I had a lot of money, I would build a free library in my village. If more children could read, they would have better futures. Rina: That's a lovely idea. If I had enough money, I would help you. Doni: And if you came to my village, you would see how much it is needed.
read.title: If I Were Rich

read.id:
Tahun lalu, Anton gagal ujian mengemudi. Jika dia berlatih lebih banyak, dia pasti lulus. Dia juga datang terlambat pada hari ujian. Jika dia berangkat lebih awal, dia tidak akan ketinggalan bagian pertama pengarahan.
Sekarang dia menyesal, tetapi dia sudah belajar dari kesalahannya. Kali ini, jika dia mempelajari aturan dengan teliti dan tidur nyenyak malam sebelumnya, dia mungkin akan lulus ujian kedua.

options: Study the rules and sleep well
qs.q: What will Anton probably do to pass the second test?

read.text:
Last year, Anton failed his driving test. If he had practised more, he would have passed. He also arrived late on the test day. If he had left home earlier, he wouldn't have missed the first part of the briefing.
Now he regrets it, but he has learned a lesson. This time, if he studies the rules carefully and sleeps well the night before, he will probably pass the second test.
